title: Quiltor sync target v1
description: The answer of GET and POST /api/sync/target?world=ID. The world's own address wins; the operator's QUILTOR_BACKUP_URL is only the fallback for a world without one (F-87-4). POST takes { backupUrl } and an empty string removes the world's own address.

backupUrl.description: The address the world syncs with: worldUrl if set, else operatorUrl, else empty.

worldUrl.description: The world's own address, normalized; empty when the world has none.

operatorUrl.description: The operator's QUILTOR_BACKUP_URL, canonical; empty when unset or unsafe.
